_comment: The factory's label set. Edit here, then run `uv run python -m factory.sync_labels --apply`. Meanings: docs/agents/triage-labels.md and docs/factory/README.md.

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on reporter for more information

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified; an agent can build it, on the laptop or by the factory

labels.name: ready-for-human
labels.description: Requires human implementation; the factory has stopped

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: in-progress
labels.description: The factory is building or reworking this ticket

labels.name: rework
labels.description: Review or CI found a blocker; a rework round fixes what it named

labels.name: factory-failed
labels.description: Factory-applied: the last Implement or Rework run on this ticket or PR failed; the next start removes it

labels.name: rework:1
labels.description: The factory blocked this PR once (review or CI)

labels.name: rework:2
labels.description: The factory blocked this PR twice; the next blocker goes to a human

labels.name: project:harness
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/harness/)

labels.name: project:agent-identity
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/agent-identity/)

labels.name: project:ai-gateway
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/ai-gateway/)

labels.name: project:agents
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/agents/)

labels.name: project:go-sandbox
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/go-sandbox/)

labels.name: project:spring-sandbox
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/spring-sandbox/)

labels.name: project:ts-sandbox
labels.description: Owner-applied: names the project this ticket builds (projects/ts-sandbox/)

labels.name: ready-for-builder
labels.description: Scout-applied: a Goal issue ready for the builder to plan (does not start the factory)

labels.name: builder:claimed
labels.description: Builder-applied: the Builder has claimed this Goal issue and is planning it

labels.name: spec:ready-for-review
labels.description: Builder-applied: spec validated; waiting for owner review (does not start the factory)

labels.name: ready-for-implementation
labels.description: Owner-applied on a spec issue: the Builder writes the Tickets and labels them ready-for-agent

labels.name: wayfinder:map
labels.description: Wayfinder map

labels.name: wayfinder:research
labels.description: Wayfinder research

labels.name: wayfinder:grilling
labels.description: Wayfinder grilling

labels.name: wayfinder:prototype
labels.description: Wayfinder prototype

labels.name: wayfinder:task
labels.description: Wayfinder task

labels.name: ready-for-factory
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory builds this ticket

labels.name: ready-for-research
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory answers this research-request ticket

labels.name: factory-check
labels.description: Owner-applied: the factory answers with a short live check
